Get TPBL Player Box Score

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_box_players.Rd

Whole-game box score lines of every player on either team sheet, keyed by GoHoops roster id.

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/games/{game_id}/stats

Usage

tpbl_box_players(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

Required. TPBL game id (integer), e.g. 6; game_id in tpbl_games. Not sequential by date (2024-25 = 1-1367, 2025-26 = 1371-8641, 2026-27 = 27535-27667). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Whole-game box score lines of every player on either team sheet, keyed by GoHoops roster id. An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py tpbl_box_players):

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerTPBL game id (key space: TPBL games on api.tpbl.basketball): the {game_id} of the game routes. Not sequential by date (2024-25 = 1-1367, 2025-26 = 1371-8641, 2026-27 = 27535-27667). The box score echoes no game id, so a box frame parsed without the request stamp has a null game_id.
sidecharacterSide of the game: home or away (the API lists the home team first and never infers it from the venue).
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id.
teamcharacterTeam name in Traditional Chinese with the sponsor (Kaohsiung Aquas, Formosa Dreamers, Hsinchu Lioneers, Taoyuan Leopards, New Taipei CTBC DEA, New Taipei Kings, Taipei Mars).
gohoops_squad_idintegerGoHoops squad id (key space: GoHoops squads = one team in one season: 8209-8215 in 2024-25, 11931-11937 in 2025-26, 15536-15542 in 2026-27; it changes every season).
player_idintegerTPBL player id (key space: TPBL players; one per person across seasons and teams): the {player_id} of the player routes. Not the GoHoops person id and not the roster id.
gohoops_person_idintegerGoHoops person id (key space: GoHoops persons; one per human). Not the TPBL player id and not the roster id.
gohoops_roster_idintegerGoHoops roster id (key space: GoHoops rosters = one player registered with one squad in one season; it changes when the player changes season or team). The key of the box score players: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on it. Not the TPBL player id and not the person id.
playercharacterPlayer name (Traditional Chinese, or a transliteration for foreign players).
numbercharacterJersey number as text (so '0' and '00' stay distinct).
positioncharacterPlaying position as a PascalCase enum: PointGuard, ShootingGuard, SmallForward, PowerForward, Center, and the combinations PointGuardAndShootingGuard, ShootingGuardAndSmallForward, SmallForwardAndPowerForward and PowerForwardAndCenter; ” when unset.
statuscharacterRegistration status of the player on the squad as of the request, not at game time: 'official', or 'withdrawn' / 'WITHDRAWN' (one state in two spellings: the player left the squad later; most withdrawn players still played).
roster_statuscharacterRoster registration status as an upper-case enum: 'OFFICIAL' in the 2026-27 preseason game; null in the 2024-25 and 2025-26 box scores (an era difference in the feed).
is_startinglogicalTrue when the player was in the starting five.
enteredlogicalTrue when the player has a stat line (he entered the game; a few such players have 0 seconds on court); false for a registered player who did not play, whose stats are all null.
time_on_courtintegerSeconds on court by the player over the whole game (436 = 7:16). A team quarter sums its five players: 3600 = 5 x 720 s (12-minute quarter), 1500 = 5 x 300 s (5-minute overtime).
scoreintegerPoints scored by the player over the whole game. The stat keys are absent for a player who did not enter the game (11 keys in all); a few players who did not play carry them with time_on_court 0.
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus: the team's point differential while the player was on court (standard definition; not independently checked).
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made by the player over the whole game.
field_goals_missedintegerField goals missed by the player over the whole game.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted by the player over the whole game.
field_goals_percentagedoubleField goals percentage by the player over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
two_pointers_madeinteger2-point field goals made by the player over the whole game.
two_pointers_missedinteger2-point field goals missed by the player over the whole game.
two_pointers_attemptedinteger2-point field goals attempted by the player over the whole game.
two_pointers_percentagedouble2-point field goals percentage by the player over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
three_pointers_madeinteger3-point field goals made by the player over the whole game.
three_pointers_missedinteger3-point field goals missed by the player over the whole game.
three_pointers_attemptedinteger3-point field goals attempted by the player over the whole game.

free_throws_missedintegerFree throws missed by the player over the whole game.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted by the player over the whole game.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes the tpbl.basketball site's own front end calls on api.tpbl.basketball (read from its JavaScript bundle). The API is keyless and needs no headers; tpbl.basketball/robots.txt answers 200 with an empty body. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Coverage: three seasons so far (2024-25 = season 2025 to 2026-27 = season 2027). There is NO play-by-play route; the two shot lists carry court coordinates only, with no shooter, game, quarter or time. Names (teams with their sponsor, venues, players, referees) are Traditional Chinese; the column descriptions translate the codes.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26). The API keys a season by its own small integer (1, 2, 3 = 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27); the runtime reads tpbl_seasons once per session and sends that id. A year the list lacks is hoopR_no_data.

  • Ids: every route takes TPBL's own ids (season, division, team, game, player); the gohoops_* ids belong to GoHoops, the stats platform behind the league, and are echoed beside them. The box score keys its players by gohoops_roster_id (a person registered with one squad in one season), not by the TPBL player id: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on gohoops_roster_id. Every id is an integer. tipoff is a POSIXct in Asia/Taipei (the API sends naive Taiwan-local times).

  • Finished games only: the game wrappers first read the game detail (cached per session) and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) a game that is not COMPLETED or still live; the box-score wrappers also refuse a stats body whose teams (in home / away order), final scores, quarter count or player points disagree with it. The season game list, the roster and the player game log are checked against the object asked for; the two shot lists name no team, player or division in the body, so only their shape and court bounds are checked. tpbl_games(verify = TRUE) also checks every division's completed games against its standings (falling back to the team-filtered lists for a division whose standings answer empty, as the 2024-25 playoffs do).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a season the API does not list, an empty list such as the standings of a playoff division), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422, an invalid verify or rounds, raised before the request where it can be) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: a non-2xx after retries, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, an unfinished game, a body that disagrees with the object asked for). HTTP 500 is retried on every route except the player game log, where an unknown division_id answers 500 deterministically: it fails after one request. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.
